title: Reasoning with Continuous Latent Diffusion
abstract: arXiv:2609.35694v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Continuous diffusion generates complete reasoning solutions through iterative refinement in latent space. We introduce the Continuous Embedding Diffusion Reasoner (CEDR), an ELF-based training and inference recipe. Our experiments show that accurate decoding alone does not ensure strong reasoning performance. We therefore learn compact representations from multiple layers of a strong autoregressive teacher. Their decomposition also enables asynchronous denoising at different rates. We show that prompt encodings need only preserve the information required for the correct text-conditional score, rather than exactly match teacher features, and use a staged curriculum to learn a compact prompt encoder that replaces the teacher Transformer at inference. We adapt DiffusionNFT to learned self-conditioning guidance and incorporate gold-solution endpoints to supplement sparse rewards. Our supervised models outperform reported results from rec

translated_title: 基于连续潜在扩散的推理
translated_abstract: 连续扩散通过在潜在空间中的迭代细化来生成完整的推理解决方案。我们提出了连续嵌入扩散推理器（CEDR），这是一种基于ELF的训练与推理方案。我们的实验表明，仅凭准确的解码并不能保证强大的推理性能。因此，我们从强大的自回归教师模型的多个层中学习紧凑的表示，而这些表示的分解还支持以不同速率进行异步去噪。我们证明，提示编码只需保留计算正确文本条件分数所需的信息，而不必精确匹配教师模型的特征，并采用分阶段课程学习来训练一个紧凑的提示编码器，在推理时替代教师Transformer。我们将DiffusionNFT适配到学习到的自条件引导中，并引入黄金解答端点来补充稀疏奖励。我们的监督模型超越了近期已报告的结果。
tldr: 提出连续嵌入扩散推理器CEDR，通过从自回归教师模型多层学习紧凑表示、训练紧凑提示编码器替代教师，并结合改进的DiffusionNFT与黄金解答端点，实现了基于连续潜在扩散的强推理性能。
en_tdlr: Proposes CEDR, a continuous embedding diffusion reasoner that learns compact multi-layer representations from an autoregressive teacher, replaces the teacher with a compact prompt encoder, and adapts DiffusionNFT with self-conditioning guidance and gold-solution endpoints to achieve strong reasoning performance.
